hints.tr: `while True:` içinde iste, `extend` et, `if page >= body["meta"]["pages"]: break`, sonra `page += 1`.
hints.en: Inside `while True:` request, `extend`, `if page >= body["meta"]["pages"]: break`, then `page += 1`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
import requests

BASE = "http://api.odyssey.test"

books = []
page = 1
requests_sent = 0
while True:
    body = requests.get(BASE + "/books", params={"page": page}).json()
    requests_sent += 1
    books.extend(body["data"])
    if page >= body["meta"]["pages"]:
        break
    page += 1

print("books:", len(books))
print("requests:", requests_sent)
for book in books[-3:]:
    print(book["title"])
```

import requests

BASE = "http://api.odyssey.test"

books = []
page = 1
requests_sent = 0
while True:
    body = requests.get(BASE + "/books", params={"page": page}).json()
    requests_sent += 1
    books.extend(body["data"])
    if page >= body["meta"]["pages"]:
        break
    page += 1

print("books:", len(books))
print("requests:", requests_sent)
for book in books[-3:]:
